verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕਮਲ ਕੁਮਦਨੀ ਕੋ ਸਸਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛਰਤ ਸੋਗ ਹਰਖ ਬਿਆਪਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: ahinis bhramat kamal kumadhanee ko sas mil bichharat sog harakh biaapahee ||

en.bdb: The lotus longs for the sun during the day while the Nymphea lotus longs for the moon at night. The lotus is distressed during the night and happy during the day. The Nymphea lotus is distressed during the day and happy at night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਹੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਮਿਲਾਪਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: rav sas ula(n)gh saran satigur gahee charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT milaapahee ||

en.bdb: Going beyond the attitude of the Sun and Moon where they meet or separate from their beloved, a Guru-conscious person takes the refuge of the True Guru, and remains absorbed in the tranquil and comforting holy feet of the True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨ ਸੁਬਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਮਧੁ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਜਾਪਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh nij aasan subaasan kai madh makara(n)dh ras lubhit ajaapahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a bumble bee is enamored by the fragrance of a flower and remains enticed in its love, so does a Guru-oriented person remains engrossed in the fragrance of elixir-like Naam in the seat of the mystical tenth door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੁਇ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਉਨਮਨ ਮਗਨ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਅਲਾਪਹੀ ॥੨੬੬॥
verses.translit_en: tiragun ateet hui bisraam nihakaam dhaam unaman magan anaahadh alaapahee ||266||

en.bdb: Free from the influence of three traits of the maya (mammon), a Guru-conscious person is ever absorbed in singing the melody of the Naam in the mystical tenth door state of high spirituality. (266)
